bio: Indulge in a decadent Afternoon Tea at Vicinity at The Tower Hotel. Standing on the north bank of the River Thames, Vicinity boasts incredible views of Tower Bridge and the Tower of London.  Afternoon Tea is served in the contemporary Vicinity Restaurant, which also features an al fresco terrace - the perfect place to relax with Afternoon Tea while enjoying the sensational views overlooking the river.  Finger sandwiches are served with classic fillings, such as smoked salmon and cream cheese and coronation chicken. Traditional desserts are served with a twist, such as Pimm's Victoria Sponge and a Rhubarb & elderflower vanilla slice.
